description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for various hardware models in an OpenWrt-based firmware. It defines procedures for image checking, upgrade steps tailored to different devices, and configuration copying, utilizing external commands like nand_do_upgrade, fw_setenv, and others.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the image, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for different hardware based on board name, executing device-specific upgrade functions and scripts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to specific devices, e.g., onhub models, via device-specific functions.
